learning_objective: 🎯 Enjoy a brilliant, humorous tale of irony and manipulation as a young writer is financially drained by a woman who claims she 'never eats anything for luncheon'!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: The narrator, a young, struggling writer living in Paris, is flattered when a lady admirer asks him to take her to lunch. She chooses Foyot's, a restaurant so expensive it's far beyond his means, but he is too embarrassed to say no.

Throughout the meal, the woman repeatedly claims, 'I never eat anything for luncheon.' Yet, she proceeds to order the most expensive items on the menu: Salmon, Caviar, Champagne, giant Asparagus, and a Peach. The writer eats a cheap mutton chop and panics about the bill.
When the bill arrives, the writer has to leave his entire month's budget as a tip and walks out completely broke. The woman leaves completely satisfied, still claiming she eats very little.
Years later, they meet again. The narrator notes with dark humor that he has finally had his revenge: the woman now weighs twenty-one stone (about 133 kg)!

fun_activity.title: 💸 The Menu Math
fun_activity.instructions: Imagine you have exactly ₹500 in your pocket to last the month. A friend invites you to a cafe and orders a pizza (₹300), a cold coffee (₹150), and a brownie (₹100). How do you get out of paying the bill without looking cheap? This was exactly the narrator's nightmare!

exam_tips: 📌 Verbal Irony: The central humor is the gap between what the woman says ('I never eat more than one thing') and what she does (ordering a massive, luxurious feast).
📌 The Narrator's weakness: The narrator falls victim to her because of his vanity and desire to appear sophisticated and gentlemanly.
📌 Poetic Justice: The ending is a perfect example of poetic justice, where the woman's gluttony naturally catches up with her physically.
quick_recap: ⭐ A struggling writer takes an admirer to a hyper-expensive restaurant.
⭐ The woman claims she eats nothing but proceeds to order the most luxurious dishes.
⭐ The writer is left completely broke, but gets the 'last laugh' years later when he sees she has become enormously overweight.
